description: This file defines the EmailService interface, declaring methods for sending emails and managing email configurations within the system.

classes.name: EmailService
classes.description: Interface for email-related operations such as sending emails and configuring email settings.

methods.name: sendHtmlEmail
methods.description: Sends an HTML email to the specified merchant store.

methods.name: getEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the email configuration for a given merchant store.

methods.name: saveEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Saves email configuration settings for a merchant store.
